content: Tɑm nɔrubu bu rɑ tɔnu ko yɑɑkoruɡii kɑ wurenuɡii. Wi u derɑ mu nùn ɡo, u ǹ bwisi mɔwɑ.
Sunɔn mɔru yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡbee sunɔn kukiribu. Bɑɑwure wi u nùn nɔɔ kuurimɔ, u win tii dokemɔwɑ kɑri sɔɔ.
Wi u ku rɑ sɑnnɔn bɑtu kɑ̃, wiyɑ bɑ koo bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ ɡɑ rɑ mɔru sewɑ fuuku.
Wi u ku rɑ wuku bɔmbɔmminun sɔ̃, ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑnɑm u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑsi.
Tɔnun ɡɔ̃run bwisikunu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe nim bweru te tɑ duku, ɑdɑmɑ wi u bwisi mɔ wiyɑ rɑ n nim mɛn tɑkɑm yɛ̃.
Tɔn dɑbirɑ tɑ rɑ n ten bɔrɔkinirun ɡɑri mɔ̀, ɑdɑmɑ wɑrɑ u nɑɑnɛ mɔ kɑ ɡem.
Gemɡii u rɑ n sĩimɔwɑ dɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔɔ. Win bibɑ ko n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ doo nɔɔruɡibu.
Sɑnɑm mɛ sinɑ boko u sinɑ u kɑ siri, yɑnde u rɑ tubuwɑ mi kɔ̃sɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Wɑrɑ koo kpĩ u nɛɛ, win ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ dɛɛre, u ǹ durum mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ ku rɑ kɑ̃ bɑ n kiɑru yĩirumɔ kɑ kilo kɑ sɑkɑku ye yɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee.
Bɑɑ bii, u rɑ sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ win kookoosu sɔɔ ù n sɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ ɡeɑɡii.
Swɑɑ si su ɡɑri nɔɔmɔ, kɑ nɔni yi yi yɑm wɑɑmɔ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u ye kpuro kuɑ.
A ku dom kĩɑ kpɑ yɑ̃ɑru tu ku rɑɑ nun wɔri. A de ɑ se bururu, kpɑ ɑ dĩɑnu wɑ ɑ di ɑ debu.
Wi u kiɑru dwemɔ u rɑ tu yɑɑ kɑsikiwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ù n tu dwɑ u kpɑ, u rɑ n tii siɑrɑmɔwɑ.
Wurɑ kun sɛ̃, wesekii ɡeenu mɑɑ yibɑ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ rɑ ɡɑri bwisiɡii ɡere, bɑ ǹ dɑbi.
Goo ù n sɔɔ ɡoo swɑɑ ɡbiiyɑ u kɑ dibu suɑ wunɛn mi, ɑ wi u yɛ̃ro ɡbiiyɑ min yɑberu tɔrubɑ mɔɔ.
Dĩɑ ni tɔnu wɑ kɑ swɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ, nu rɑ n ɡinɑ dibu dowɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɑmɛn biru, nu rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yɑnim nɔɔwɔ.
Tɔnu ù n bwisi kɛ̃ɔ ɡeo wɑ, ye u niɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ rɑ koorewɑ. A ku tɑbu dɑ bìn sɔɔru ɑ ǹ kue.
Kɔrumɔtɔ kowo u rɑ ɑsiri kpɑrewɑ. A be bɑ rɑ ɡɑri sɑɑri too dukɑ suurio.
Wi u win mɛro ǹ kun mɛ win tundo bɔ̃rusi, u koo ɡbiwɑ nɡe fitilɑ.
Dukiɑ ye tɔnu u wɑ fuuku, ɑmɛn biru yɑ ku rɑ n domɑru mɔ.
A ku nɛɛ, kɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kɔsiɑ ye bɑ nun kuɑ. A ɡesi wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokeo Yinni Gusunɔ sɔɔ, u koo nun fɑɑbɑ ko.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ kɑ̃ bɑ n kiɑru yĩirumɔ kɑ kilo ye yɑ ǹ dee dee sɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ tɔnun wɑ̃ɑru kpɑre. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, tɔnu kun kpɛ̃ u ɡiɑ mi win sɑnu sɑnusu kɑ nùn dɔɔ.
Kɑri bɑkɑ, ɑ̀ n Gusunɔ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ nùn yeni kɛ̃. N deemɑ ɑ ǹ bwisikɑ.
Sunɔ bwisiɡii u rɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu sikiewɑ mi bɑ sebi, kpɑ u bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ u kun ben wɔnwɔndu kue.
Tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡe Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn wɛ̃ ɡu kɑ win sɔɔwɔ yɑm bururɑsiɑ.
Sinɑ boko wi u nɑɑnɛ mɔ, mɑ u win tɔmbu kĩ, u ku rɑ nɑnde. Ù n mɑɑ bu sirimɔ ɡem sɔɔ, win bɑndɑ koo tɛ.
Dɑmɑ mu sɑ̃ɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑn bɛɛrɛ. Seri kpiki yiyɑ yi mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ bukurobun bɛɛrɛ.
Bɑ̀ n nuku kɔ̃suruɡii so bɑ mɛɛrɑ kuɑ, win nuku kɔ̃suru tɑ koo kpe, kpɑ u bwisi ko.
